jobs.title: AI Enablement and Learning Specialist
jobs.description: Superside is reinventing how its people learn, and we're looking for someone to help bring that vision to life in practical, AI-powered ways. As an AI Enablement and Learning Specialist, you'll join the Learning Enablement and Transformation team. You'll work closely with the person leading our learning strategy, turning goals and ideas into working solutions: Claude-supported resources, automated workflows, and well-organized knowledge that people can actually find and use. You'll also keep the systems and knowledge behind our learning programs in good order, so everything runs smoothly with little manual effort. This isn't a traditional L&D role. If you love working with information, enjoy building with AI and automation tools, and care about how people learn, you'll feel at home here. You'll work independently, from ideas and open problems rather than step-by-step briefs, in a fully remote, ambitious, async-first team. What you'll do Research practical, AI-powered ways to deliver on our learning goals, and recommend what's worth implementing. Prototype Claude-supported learning resources and automations, and turn the best ones into working solutions. Build and launch new learning initiatives, from first idea to something people use. Run and improve async onboarding, so new joiners get a smooth, mostly automated experience. Organize and maintain our learning knowledge, so it's easy to find, trust and keep up to date. Automate enrolments, reminders, tracking and reporting across our learning systems. Look after our learning systems and tools such as Sana LMS, Notion, Claude so they stay reliable and easy to use. Create learning content when needed, such as short modules, guides and resources. Work with stakeholders across the company to understand their learning needs and turn them into practical solutions. What you'll need to succeed Strong experience organizing and managing knowledge: structuring information, keeping it current, and making it easy to use. Hands-o

jobs.title: AI Trainer
jobs.location: US, UK, Canada, Australia + 35 other countries
jobs.description: Remote | Independent Contractor | Get certified for future project opportunities Prove your skills. Get certified. Be ready for what comes next. Robotics AI is advancing rapidly, and high-quality video data helps intelligent systems better understand the world around them. We are inviting detail-oriented professionals to complete our certification process for potential robotics AI projects. Demonstrate your skills now and be considered when project opportunities become available. What You Will Do As part of the certification process, you will demonstrate your ability to: Annotate short video clips by identifying objects, actions and events. Evaluate video quality, relevance and accuracy against established guidelines. Assess the clarity and plausibility of movements. Apply instructions consistently and identify potential quality issues. What You Bring Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking. Strong written English and the ability to follow detailed instructions independently. A commitment to accuracy and consistency. No previous AI or robotics experience required. What the Work Looks Like You may review short videos and be asked to tag objects or actions, rate video clarity or camera angles on a 1 to 10 scale, or assess whether movements are clearly visible and plausible. Why Get Certified Now Completing certification in advance allows you to demonstrate your qualifications and be considered for relevant independent contractor engagements when opportunities become available. Please note: Certification does not guarantee a project engagement, assignment or paid work. Future opportunities depend on project availability and applicable selection criteria. Please mention the word **SUPREME** and tag RNTIuMTczLjIyMS4zNw== when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNTIuMTczLjIyMS4zNw==). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.
